biography:
== Biography ==
James Mullen was born in Charlestown, Massachusetts, about 1829, the son of Patrick Mullen and Ellen Loan, who were both born in Ireland.<ref name="jamesdeath">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NW5H-PJT : accessed 18 November 2026), James Mullen, died 1905 (8 Dec 1905 per the town record), Boston; age 76, born Charlestown; widowed; undertaker; burial Calvary; parents Patrick Mullen and Ellen Loan, both born Ireland.</ref>

He married Catherine McElaney (McLaney), who was born in East Cambridge about 1828, the daughter of Thomas and Susan McElaney.<ref name="cathdeath">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:N7RS-674 : accessed 18 November 2026), Catharine McElaney Mullen, died 1872 (13 Oct 1872 per the town record, https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FHGK-ZKH), Boston; age 44, born E. Cambridge; married, spouse James; parents Thomas and Susan, both born Ireland; vol. 249 p. 207.</ref> They were probably the James Mullin and Catherine McLaney who married at Sandwich on 24 August 1851.<ref name="marr1851">"Massachusetts, Town Clerk, Vital and Town Records, 1626-2001", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:Q29L-JNBG : accessed 18 November 2026), James Mullin and Catherine McLaney, married 24 Aug 1851, Sandwich, Barnstable, Massachusetts; p. 36.</ref> Their daughter Susan T. was born in Cambridge on 24 August 1857, when James was a coffin maker.<ref name="susanbirth">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FXCL-6C3 : accessed 18 November 2026), Susan T. Mullen, born 24 Aug 1857, Cambridge, Middlesex; Cambridge births 1857, p. 77, no. 335 (film 004341179, image 922). Parents James and Catherine Mullen; father a coffin maker, born Charlestown; mother born Cambridge.</ref> Susan married James W. O'Donnell in Boston in 1882.<ref name="marr1882">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NW5J-1BC : accessed 18 November 2026), James W. O'Donnell and Susan T. Mullen, married 21 Sep 1882, Boston, entry 2849. Bride 21, born Cambridge, parents James and Catharine.</ref>

Catherine died in Boston in October 1872.<ref name="cathdeath" /> James, by then an undertaker, died a widower in Boston on 8 December 1905, aged 76, and was buried at Calvary Cemetery.<ref name="jamesdeath" />

=== Research Notes ===
* The 1851 Sandwich marriage is linked by name only (spelling McLaney); a Find a Grave memorial for Catherine McLaney Mullen (died 1872, Mount Calvary) supports it.
* Siblings, censuses (1860 Cambridge, 1865-1880 Boston) and his parents' immigration are not yet researched.

== Sources ==
